name: lnb
description: Turn Claude into your team's market-intelligence analyst. Evidence-cited research on vendors, pain points, trends and market sizing, captured to a shared workspace.
long_description:
LNB is a shared market-intelligence workspace. Ask Claude to research a vendor, mine pain points, size a market or brief the team, and every finding is saved as a structured, evidence-cited entry your whole team can see on a live dashboard.

This bundle connects Claude Desktop to the hosted LNB server and carries everything it needs. On first use it opens a browser to sign you in; a personal workspace is created automatically, and you can join a team workspace with its invite code.
